26 Tips I Wish I Knew Before Visiting Bali

spots.name: Padang Padang Beach
spots.description: A famous white sand beach in the Uluwatu area made internationally known by the movie Eat Pray Love. It offers stunning coastal scenery and is a must-visit in southern Bali.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI: A Tropical Paradise | Full Travel Guide 2026 | Bali travel in 4k
mentions.quote: Visit Padang Padang Beach made famous by the movie Eat Pray Love.

spots.name: Uluwatu Temple
spots.description: An iconic Hindu sea temple perched dramatically on the edge of a cliff in southern Bali. The creator recommends staying for the traditional Kecak fire dance at sunset, with tickets at just $4.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI: A Tropical Paradise | Full Travel Guide 2026 | Bali travel in 4k
mentions.quote: For the perfect sunset, head to Ulu Watu Temple perched on the edge of a dramatic cliff.

spots.name: Tegallalang Rice Terraces
spots.description: A breathtaking terraced rice landscape near Ubud that the creator says feels like a painting. Entry is around $1 and it is one of Bali's most iconic natural sights.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI: A Tropical Paradise | Full Travel Guide 2026 | Bali travel in 4k
mentions.quote: Explore the Tagalang rice terraces, a breathtaking landscape that feels like a painting.

spots.name: The Yoga Barn
spots.description: A well-known yoga studio in Ubud where visitors can take yoga classes. The creator recommends it as part of the spiritual and wellness experience Ubud offers.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI: A Tropical Paradise | Full Travel Guide 2026 | Bali travel in 4k
mentions.quote: Take a yoga class at the yoga barn.

spots.name: Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary
spots.description: A nature reserve and temple complex in Ubud where over 1,000 long-tailed macaques roam freely. The creator highlights it as a must-see attraction in Ubud.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI: A Tropical Paradise | Full Travel Guide 2026 | Bali travel in 4k
mentions.quote: Don't miss the sacred monkey forest where over 1,000 long-tailed macaques roam freely.

mentions.videoTitle: 26 Tips I Wish I Knew Before Visiting Bali
mentions.quote: Monkey Forest up in Ubud — is it worth it, is it safe? The answer is yes, it is definitely worth it, it is a really unique experience.

spots.name: Tirta Gangga
spots.description: A royal water palace on Bali's east coast featuring koi-filled pools and intricate stone carvings. Entry is just $2 and it is recommended for those seeking a less touristy experience.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI: A Tropical Paradise | Full Travel Guide 2026 | Bali travel in 4k
mentions.quote: Stop by Terta Ganga, a royal water palace with koi filled pools and stone carvings.

spots.name: Virgin Beach
spots.description: A hidden white sand beach on Bali's east coast with crystal-clear waters. The creator recommends getting fresh grilled fish at a beach shack for just $5.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI: A Tropical Paradise | Full Travel Guide 2026 | Bali travel in 4k
mentions.quote: Visit Virgin Beach, a hidden white sand paradise with crystal-clear waters.

spots.name: Nusa Penida
spots.description: A rugged, largely untouched island reachable by a 45-minute speedboat from Sanur. The creator recommends it for dramatic beaches, cliff landscapes, and marine life encounters.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI: A Tropical Paradise | Full Travel Guide 2026 | Bali travel in 4k
mentions.quote: Take a 45-minute speedboat to Nusa Penida, a rugged, untouched island.

spots.name: Kelingking Beach
spots.description: An iconic beach on Nusa Penida where the cliffs dramatically form the shape of a T-Rex. The creator notes the hike down is steep but the view is unreal.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI: A Tropical Paradise | Full Travel Guide 2026 | Bali travel in 4k
mentions.quote: Here you'll find Kelingking Beach, where the cliffs form the shape of a T-Rex.

spots.name: Manta Point
spots.description: A famous snorkeling and diving spot off Nusa Penida where visitors can swim with manta rays or snorkel in vibrant coral gardens for around $30. A top marine wildlife experience in Bali.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI: A Tropical Paradise | Full Travel Guide 2026 | Bali travel in 4k
mentions.quote: Swim with manta rays at Manta Point or snorkel in vibrant coral gardens for about $30.

spots.name: Canggu
spots.description: Bali's trendy beach town in the south, full of hip cafes, surf schools, and boutique shops. The creator recommends taking a surf lesson for $20 and enjoying the Bali sunset at Echo Beach.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI: A Tropical Paradise | Full Travel Guide 2026 | Bali travel in 4k
mentions.quote: End your journey in Canggu, Bali's trendy beach town — it's full of hip cafes, surf schools, and boutique shops.

mentions.videoTitle: 26 Tips I Wish I Knew Before Visiting Bali
mentions.quote: I was staying in the changu area and from the airport it only costs about $7–8 for that ride.

spots.name: Echo Beach
spots.description: A popular beachfront spot in Canggu known for its sunset views and beachfront cafes. The creator specifically calls it out as the ideal place to enjoy the iconic Bali sunset.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI: A Tropical Paradise | Full Travel Guide 2026 | Bali travel in 4k
mentions.quote: Enjoy the Bali sunset at Echo Beach.
